sources.author: Rudolf Steiner; Karl E. Zimmer, translator
sources.edition: Cosmic Memory: Prehistory of Earth and Man;GA11;Rudolf Steiner Publications Inc.,1959;translated from Aus der Akasha-Chronik
sources.locator: Cover GA011_cover.html identifies Zimmer and authorized Western Hemisphere translation;chapterii GA011_c02.html From the Akasha Chronicle(Preface)
sources.finding: Cover and original translated preface inspected. Steiner calls the claimed nonsensory historical script Akasha Chronicle, acknowledges spiritual perception can err, and points to a different work for developing cognition. Cosmological narratives and historical root-race terminology are attributed doctrine, not verified archaeology, modern human taxonomy or Howe's prayer protocol. Preface is not a complete stepwise access manual.
sources.rights_note: Index says archive presents volume with Nachlassverwaltung permission and1959 copyright. That permission is specific to archive;no downstream translation/corpus license verified. Original factual notes only;no translated paragraphs copied.
